display_long_description:
Test your focus and hand-eye coordination in a minimalist VR world! Neon Ball combines the thrill of classic arcade games with a modern, immersive "wire loop" mechanic.

How to Play? Your goal is simple but challenging: Keep the ball connected to the infinitely stretching, twisting line.

Rotate & Align: The neon track constantly twists, turns, and spirals. Use your controller to rotate the ball and match the wire's angle instantly.

Stay Focused: As you progress, the speed increases and the angles get sharper. Keep your eyes on the path!

Survive: One wrong move and you fall into the void. How far can you go?

Game Features:

Stunning Neon Atmosphere: Enjoy a clean, stylish, and minimalist visual experience that is easy on the eyes.

Precision Control: Feel the 1:1 precision with your VR controllers. Every movement counts.

Increasing Difficulty: Dynamic tracks that get faster and harder, pushing your reflexes to the limit.

Endless Challenge: Compete against yourself to beat your high score.

Defy gravity on this challenging neon course. Download now and see how fast you can react!
